verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for an AI coding workbench, but the evidence documents no scheduler, cron, or recurring automation. The closest items are Goal-based multi-step execution and remote invocation via WeChat, Feishu or Telegram. Both are one-off or on-demand triggers, not recurring schedules, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
